title: MrVoteTrain
description: The Ultimate plugin for voting, you can define vote goals.
body:
[❢] Supported Versions: 1.21.x
[❢] Requirements: Java 17, NuVotifier

*Older versions are not and will not be supported*


## ✨ About the Plugin MrVoteTrain is a plugin that allows players to vote to complete voting goals and earn rewards or voting points and more. ## ✨ Features - Voting Rewards - Voting Point System - Custom Vote Providers (Like you can make reviews rewards) - Voting Goals ## ✨ Commands ### Player Command - `/vote` – Send vote links ### Admin Commands - `/mvt start/stop` – Starting/Stoping vote train goal - `/mvt reload` – Reload plugin configuration - `/mvt points take ` – Remove points from a player - `/mvt points set ` – Set player's points to specific amount - `/mvt points give ` – Give points to a player ## ✨ Permissions ### Player Permission - `mrvotetrain.command.vote` – Allow player to get vote links ### Admin Permissions - `mrvotetrain.reload` – Reload plugin configuration - `mrvotetrain.points` – Base permission for points management commands - `mrvotetrain.points.take` – Remove points from players - `mrvotetrain.points.set` – Set player's points - `mrvotetrain.points.give` – Give points to players - `mrvotetrain.command.start` – Starts vote train goal - `mrvotetrain.command.stop` – Stop vote train goal ## ✨ PlaceholderAPI ### Player Statistics - `%mrlibcore_mvt_votes%` – Player's total votes - `%mrlibcore_mvt_points%` – Player's vote points ### Server Statistics - `%mrlibcore_mvt_current_votes%` – Current total server votes - `%mrlibcore_mvt_needed_votes%` – Votes needed to reach goal (from config) ### Leaderboards - `%mrlibcore_mvt_top__votes%` – Top player name (by votes) - `%mrlibcore_mvt_top__points%` – Top player name (by points) - `%mrlibcore_mvt_top__vname%` – Top player votes count - `%mrlibcore_mvt_top__pname%` – Top player points count ## ✨ Plugin Preview You can found preview images on Gallery
